title: Use your hands for praise, not stain
summary: This meets a body acting all day without much of it turning upward. The line blesses hands used for praise and clean work.
takeaway: Ask what your hands are serving.
lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive grab, type, or reach, ask what your hands are serving. Give them one act today that leaves the soul cleaner.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive reach, ask what your hands are serving.

evidence.coreClaim: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
evidence.turn: Let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next reflexive grab, type, or reach, ask what your hands are serving. Give them one act today that leaves the soul cleaner.
